purpose: Read-only consolidated view of every pending Shine Defence review candidate and the next action needed to move that exact release forward.
scope: Only candidates with status pending_review appear in the live review queue. Finalized candidates remain in review-candidates-v1 history but are not active queue items.

states.meaning: The pending candidate has no canonical structured review checklist yet.
A valid pending checklist exists and at least one requirement is still unreviewed.
Every checklist requirement is satisfied and explicit human approval is the next decision.
No checklist requirements remain unreviewed and at least one requirement is not_satisfied.
Human approval is valid and the app has no existing reviewed-ledger entry.
Human approval is valid and the app already has a reviewed-ledger entry.
Human rejection is valid but the candidate is still pending_review and needs a final candidate dismissal decision.
A checklist exists but no longer validates against the exact candidate and current canonical registry.

rules: The queue is read-only and never changes candidate, checklist, review-decision, certification, receipt or revocation state.
Queue items are sorted deterministically by observedAt then candidateId.
Checklist counts report total, satisfied, not_satisfied and unreviewed requirements.
When a checklist is pending and has unreviewed requirements, nextAction identifies the first unreviewed checklist item in canonical checklist order.
Evidence-assistance state reports missing, valid or invalid independently from checklist authority.
Evidence gaps are advisory information only and never make a requirement automatically satisfied or not_satisfied.
An approved checklist routes to first certification when the app is absent from the reviewed ledger and to re-certification when it is already present.
A rejected checklist does not silently mutate the candidate to dismissed; the queue exposes final candidate closure as the next action.
Invalid authoritative checklist state blocks readiness. Invalid advisory suggestion state is surfaced distinctly and must not be used by the workspace until repaired.
The queue can be rendered as human-readable text or deterministic JSON without persisting a new authority artifact.
nonClaims: The queue does not decide whether a requirement is satisfied.
The queue does not approve, reject, dismiss, supersede, certify or revoke releases.
Evidence-gap counts are workflow assistance, not a security score.
